appDescription: A vehicle app for leaving voice memories at places and listening on later visits.

function.name: START_CAPSULE_RECORDING
function.description: Record up to fifteen seconds of a voice memory at the current location after explicit user request and prior trip preparation.

function.name: SAVE_CAPSULE_RECORDING
function.description: Finish the current voice recording and save it at its starting location.

function.name: CANCEL_CAPSULE_RECORDING
function.description: Cancel the current voice recording and discard its audio.
